deploy-bot: :information_source: TEMP PIN enacted by sara: runtime v5.1 pinned for model-group 'mix-llama' in us-west-2 due to increased tail latency during the nightly batch job. Pin duration 6h. See https://ops/inc/1723459990

sara: noticed p99 jump around 02:40 PST, looks like new runtime scheduling interacts poorly with batching heuristics from SDK 4.1.0. pin to avoid more customer-facing spikes.

omar: ok. can we route traffic for large-batch requests to runtime v5.0 in us-west-2 and keep small requests on v5.1? would reduce impact.

rachel: deploy-bot can do header-based routing (x-batch-size). suggested rule: batch_size>64 -> runtime:v5.0. Also we should pause SDK canary and open a quick revert patch.

deploy-bot: Available commands (requires ops role):

```
/deploy pin runtime v5.1 --model mix-llama --region us-west-2 --by sara --until 2024-06-10T10:40Z
/deploy route add --from runtime:v5.1 --to runtime:v5.0 --region us-west-2 --match "header:x-batch-size>64"
/deploy canary pause sdk 4.1.0
```

omar: routing applied, smoke shows p99 for large-batch back to baseline within 10m. small request p95 unchanged.

sara: i'm scheduling a soft-unpin for 03:30 PST tomorrow with condition gates: p99 <= baseline+20% AND error-rate < 0.5% for 20m. rollback rule: if p99 > baseline+30% OR errors >1% -> auto rollback to v5.0 and page eng-oncall.

rachel: i've filed PR for SDK revert+guard: https://git/repo/pull/5512 1: will add deterministic batching threshold.

omar: please add a postmortem checklist item: verify kernel selection doesn't flip under high concurrency for quantized models.

sara: release note draft: "Temporary pin of runtime v5.1 in us-west-2 for mix-llama due to nightly batch p99 regressions. Traffic for large batches routed to v5.0 until SDK patch is deployed. No customer data loss; possible increased latency for large-batch workloads during mitigation." posting to #release-notes after approvals.

deploy-bot: Pin remains in effect. To request earlier unpin run `/deploy unpin runtime v5.1 --region us-west-2` and tag eng-releases.

sara: thanks team. i'll update this thread with gate numbers during soft-unpin and close when fully unwound.
